title: Anaemia in women 15-49, LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS compared with the World
headline: Anaemia in women: LDCs and SIDS are 8.5 points apart
subtitle: Percentage of women aged 15-49 years with a haemoglobin level less than 120 g/L for non-pregnant women and lactating women, and less than 110 g/L for pregnant women, adjusted for altitude and smoking
data_line: Data: WHO via UN SDG Global Database, series SH_STA_ANEM, SH_STA_ANEM_NPRG, SH_STA_ANEM_PREG, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Anaemia in women: LDCs and SIDS are 8.5 points apart. LDCs 37.2%, SIDS 28.7%, in 2023. LDCs 37.2%; LLDCs 32.2%; SIDS 28.7%; World 30.7%, 2023.
question: What would it take to close the gap in anaemia in women between Least developed countries and Small island developing states?
